title: Playback stalls when playing broken H.264 stream
body:
Playback stalls at 22 seconds, when playing this particular stream that I sent to dev.exoplayer@gmail.com in both an Amlogic android device, and in Bluestacks android emulator under Windows.

When the same stream is opened in other players like VLC the first 22 s of the segment is played twice, but then the rest of the segment is played so playback does not stall.
